source.name: Official Bedrock server: stored 256 × 256 biome area
source.evidence: Official BDS 1.26.61.1 build 53069370, exact seed and Experiments off verified from level.dat. Saved 256 generated chunks, X/Z -128..127, using temporary barriers restored immediately. Extracted 196608 stored cells at Y -48,0,64 from a stopped DB copy. Prior local checks: 867/867 corresponding API points match; wider cells are decoded game data, not individually API checked. Y128 excluded due differences. Numeric ID/name mapping checked against GeyserMC/mappings biomes.json. Selected landmarks are game locator coordinates, Y unknown. No global prediction engine enabled.
